name: SkillGraph
description: Upload your resume, let AI analyze your skill graph, and get a personalized action plan to become the candidate every recruiter wants.

paragraphs: AI career and placement platform for Indian engineering students, placement cells and recruiters
Find your skill gaps against live job demand, close them with focused sprints, track academics and placement drives, and apply with a résumé tailored to every job.
Features · Gallery · Architecture · Tech stack · Run locally · Roadmap · Decision records
features: Skill-gap analysis. Your résumé's skills are compared with what recent postings for your target role ask for. Gaps are ranked by urgency, ignoring skills you have by implication (React ⇒ HTML/CSS) and alternative stacks…
7-day sprints. A day-by-day plan with free resources, a mini task and a checkpoint for each day. It is built from your most urgent gaps or from topics you choose. Progress is saved per day.
Market intelligence. Weekly skill demand by role, live job search and salary lookups (JSearch), and an India market view by city and company tier.
Benchmark. See where your readiness sits against students targeting the same role, nationally and in your college.
Project ideas, LinkedIn optimiser and India career advisor. AI suggestions grounded in your own skills and gaps.

requirements.text: Self-service data export and account deletion, with consent recorded at sign-up (Privacy, Terms).
Rate limits per user or token on sign-in, AI, payments, check-in codes, chat and paid job-search calls.
